product_zh: SAEE 智能体上线准备平台
description: Evaluate declared Agent trace metadata and required execution-evidence coverage before a separately authorized deployment decision.
use_when: An Agent is preparing a high-impact or externally consequential action.
A workflow needs missing test, rollback, permission, or human-approval evidence.
A Qianfan or MCP reviewer needs a read-only structured readiness result.
do_not_use_when: The caller needs deployment authorization, runtime blocking, or permission enforcement.
The caller requests security, compliance, legal, or production certification.
The input contains customer, personal, secret, or unapproved production data.
The task is a simple low-risk lookup, rewrite, or calculation.
